text_blocks.snippet: Common side effects of losartan include dizziness, fatigue, and a stuffy nose, while rare but serious risks involve high potassium levels or kidney damage.
snippet_highlighted_words: dizziness, fatigue, and a stuffy nose

text_blocks.snippet: You can read more detailed safety information on the Mayo Clinic Losartan Guide.
These symptoms are usually mild and often improve as your body gets used to the medicine:
Get medical help right away if you notice these dangerous signs:

list.snippet: High potassium levels (hyperkalemia): Can cause muscle weakness, confusion, or an irregular heartbeat.
Kidney problems: Can cause swelling in your feet or hands, or less urine.
Severe low blood pressure: Can cause fainting or extreme dizziness.
Allergic reaction (angioedema): Causes dangerous swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat and trouble breathing.
